# koray.dev

> Koray Güler — founder and product engineer. Fintech, applied AI, and small teams. Notes on money, models and shipping alone.

Written and maintained by Koray Güler in İstanbul. Contact: id@koray.dev.
The whole site is static and public; nothing here is behind a login.

## Writing

- [Evals before prompts](https://koray.dev/writing/evals-before-prompts/): 2026-06-12, 3 min. For a year I wrote prompts the way I once wrote code without tests: carefully, confidently, and with no way of knowing when I broke something. Writing the eval first fixed that, and it cost less than an afternoon.
- [Ledgers are append-only opinions](https://koray.dev/writing/ledgers-are-append-only-opinions/): 2026-05-03, 2 min. Why every fintech eventually writes its own ledger, and how to make peace with that. A balance is not a number you store; it is an argument you can replay.
- [The token budget of a checkout flow](https://koray.dev/writing/the-token-budget-of-a-checkout-flow/): 2026-04-21, 2 min. What an LLM actually costs when it sits on the critical path of a payment — measured in milliseconds and in incidents, not in cents per million tokens.
- [Shipping alone: my build loop](https://koray.dev/writing/shipping-alone-my-build-loop/): 2026-02-08, 1 min. The exact week-shape that lets one person run three products without lying to themselves about what got done.
- [Turkish IBANs and the joy of boring code](https://koray.dev/writing/turkish-ibans-and-the-joy-of-boring-code/): 2025-11-17, 1 min. A 200-line library, 40 test cases, and zero incidents in two years. A short argument for writing the unglamorous thing yourself.
- [We chose Postgres over a queue](https://koray.dev/writing/we-chose-postgres-over-a-queue/): 2025-08-02, 1 min. Sometimes the boring database is the whole architecture. What we replaced, what it cost, and the numbers two years later.

- [Work](https://koray.dev/work/): Ventures under koative, the open source I maintain, and the products I am shipping right now.
- [Writing](https://koray.dev/writing/): Essays on fintech, applied AI and small-team engineering. Long pieces when the thinking is finished, short notes when it isn't.
- [Stack](https://koray.dev/stack/): Editor, build chain, infrastructure and AI tooling — audited once a year, kept only when it earns its place.
- [Library](https://koray.dev/library/): Tools worth opening, prompts worth running, repositories worth reading, and the config files I would rebuild a machine from.
- [About](https://koray.dev/about/): Product engineer turned founder. Six years in payments, now building applied-AI fintech from İstanbul.
